levels.surface: سعيد بن خالد بن عمرو بن عثمان

notes: The text opens mid-chain with «قال ابن شهاب»; no previous report is supplied, so the chain is read from this text alone.
«أنه سأل عروة»: Sa'id is the asker and Urwa, the one asked, answers, so both are links (rule 5).
«أنا أحدثه، هذا الحديث» is a remark, left out. Urwa is named twice and is one link.
